name: starry-acropolis-theme
description: Claude Desktop 星空外觀：天色跟著真實的太陽，月亮照真實的位置與月相（含月食），當地下雪時飄雪；介面在日出日落時自動切換深淺。A sky over an ancient-Greek acropolis that follows the real sun and moon, for the Claude Desktop Code tab.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Where you are, for sunrise and sunset (north is positive). Default: Taoyuan, Taiwan.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Where you are, for sunrise and sunset (east is positive). Default: Taoyuan, Taiwan.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: auto: snow falls when Open-Meteo reports snow where you are (sends your latitude and longitude to open-meteo.com every 30 minutes); off: no weather, no network; snow: always snowing.
